rationale: The only held text for EO:1843 is a Civil Service Commission annual-report note on a proposed waiver for Mrs. Mary R. Geddings dated October 22, 1913, which states the Commission 'does not recommend that an Executive order be issued in this case.' It does not show an order was issued under this number or what it commanded. The only citation hit is Public Land Order No. 1843, an unrelated instrument. A claim of force or ending cannot rest on a CSC comment. Research-only proposal; text is a working text, original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
material_gaps: The text of Executive Order 1843 itself (Federal Register/NARA/Richardson copy) confirming its issue and operative wording.
If issued, it is a one-person appointment waiver (ruling 2026-10-28): evidence of whether the appointment occurred is also needed.
